categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Industries exercising powers under the Societies Ordinance to authorize and exempt specific societies. It deals with legal/regulatory matters - specifically the application and modification of an existing ordinance (Chapter 123) through statutory instruments. While it mentions a government minister by name, the primary focus is on regulatory actions (authorizing purposes and limiting application of the ordinance) rather than personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel type.
